title: 子矩形查询
summary: 设计二维矩形，支持把指定闭合子矩形全部更新为同一值，并查询任意单元格。
insight: 约束允许每次更新直接遍历目标区域；查询即可常数时间读取当前矩阵。
pitfalls: 更新边界 row2、col2 都包含
构造时复制矩阵避免外部修改影响

solutions.title: 立即更新子矩形
solutions.idea: 每次操作把矩形范围内所有单元格直接改写。
steps: updateSubrectangle 双循环 row1..row2、col1..col2 赋 newValue

code.java: class SubrectangleQueries { private final int[][] rectangle;public SubrectangleQueries(int[][] rectangle){this.rectangle=new int[rectangle.length][];for(int i=0;i<rectangle.length;i++)this.rectangle[i]=rectangle[i].clone();}public void updateSubrectangle(int row1,int col1,int row2,int col2,int newValue){for(int row=row1;row<=row2;row++)for(int col=col1;col<=col2;col++)rectangle[row][col]=newValue;}public int getValue(int row,int col){return rectangle[row][col];} }
code.cpp: class SubrectangleQueries { vector<vector<int>> rectangle;public:SubrectangleQueries(vector<vector<int>>& rectangle):rectangle(rectangle){}void updateSubrectangle(int row1,int col1,int row2,int col2,int newValue){for(int row=row1;row<=row2;++row)for(int col=col1;col<=col2;++col)rectangle[row][col]=newValue;}int getValue(int row,int col){return rectangle[row][col];} };
